description: A small creek is a reminder of the tiny beauty around me -- morning light filters through the dense canopy, illuminating a group of yellowjackets at the water; a mushroom grows atop a tree trunk; a perfect spiderweb is seemingly suspended in mid-air.

name: Shasta Trinity NF
description: Those loud bugs!!! What are they?? and walking footsteps. An exposed ridge, the sun beats down. The funky bugs are everywhere hiding in the bushes, creating a ruckus when I walk by.

description: Walking through a puddle! Same as above. There must have been rain recently, though today's heat and blue skies show no indiciation that it ever happened.

name: Oregon
description: Bees in the wildflowers! Last night right before camp I crossed the border into Oregon -- finally!!!! Today another day full of wildflowers, denser forests, and sweeping vistas across multi colored landscapes.

name: Huge rock slides create sections of volcanic scree which...
description: Huge rock slides create sections of volcanic scree which slows my travel. I roll into camp at exactly 30 miles for the day, praying for soft dirt again.

name: Sky Lakes Wilderness
description: Morning birds, a crisp, cool morning. Red and yellow dirt and huckleberries everywhere. Little did I know that this would be my final day on trail.

name: Sky Lakes Wilderness
description: Nighttime crickets. Late this afternoon, my foot pain got so bad, that I made the difficult decision to turn around and head back towards Hwy 3.
